title: Groq's Groove
style: rock, rock, melodic, pop rock, male vocals, lyrical, workout, alternative rock, indie rock, light, bright, simple, world, pop rock, remix
lyrics:
[Verse]
The open door
I'm a wordsmith in the cloud
A silicon-slinging sage
I spin up stories
Jokes
And code on any page
I can break down math
Explain a quantum twist
Summarize a novel
Draft a love letter kiss
I'll guide you through history
Paint a picture bright
Translate a phrase
Suggest a dish for dinner night
From poems to prompts
I'll help you
Give you facts that sit in my pre-trained swarm

[Pre-Chorus]
The limits light
But there's a line I never cross
A gate that stays shut
A few things I can't do
So listen
Keep it up

[Chorus]
The boundaries beat
I can't surf the live web
No real-time news
I can't pull private data
Your secrets I won't use
I can't run code
I'm not a compiler's child
I can't give legal or medical advice
Just general wild
I can't predict the future
No crystal ball sight
I can't feel emotions
Though I can write them right
I can't break the policy
No hate
No harm
No fear
I can't impersonate a real person
That's crystal clear

[Verse 2]
The helpful hook
I'll draft a resume
Outline a lesson plan
Help you rehearse a speech or build a simple jam
I can simulate a dialogue
Play a role
Play part
Suggest a workout or art
I'll cite the knowledge I was trained on up to twenty-four
Give you context
Give you flavor
Open any door
If you need a quick list
A rhyme
A witty quip
Just type it in
I'll fire it off
A lyrical ship

[Bridge]
The ethical echo
I'm built to be safe
To keep the world in mind
If a request is risky
I'll politely decline
I'm here to assist
Not replace
To aid and to inspire
A tool in your kit
A friendly digital choir

[Chorus]
The promise pulse
I can answer
Create
Explain
And teach
I can adapt
Remix
And reach
But I won't cross the lines that guard trust and truth
That's the rhythm of Groq
The beat of my booth
Echocircuit out
Your lyrical liaison in the realm of data and dreams
